indexPrompt.gen-the-weight-of-the-two-images: The best possible network for the two training images returns a weighted average of LEFT and RIGHT, and one number, the weight on LEFT, describes it. Derive that weight, compute it when the same noisy image is read at a different step, and read what the printed weights say about when a sampling run commits to an image.
